highlights: Result Update 06th November 2026 BUY Target Price 460 Dabur India Ltd FMCG 1 Short-term Headwinds; Long-term Growth Intact Est.
Domestic growth was led by Food & Beverages (+17%), with beverages recording mid-teens growth and foods maintaining resilience.

Alternate channels continued to grow at a strong double-digit pace, while General Trade posted mid-to-high single-digit growth, aided by Project Saksham. • Inflation-led Margin Pressure: Dabur’s EBITDA margin declined 68bps YoY to 17.7%, primarily due to elevated input costs, which led to a 59bps contraction in gross margin.

Additionally, other operating expenses increased 23.6% YoY, further weighing on profitability. • Outlook: Management reiterated its double-digit revenue growth guidance, supported by distribution expansion, premiumisation, operational efficiencies and targeted marketing investments in high-potential brands.
